model.name: Room membership dedup by resolved identity (structural, no duplicate members ever)
model.description: Duplicate room membership for one identity is made STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE via four enforcement points plus an immutable redirectTo: (a) room load collapses members through resolveToken so room.members holds <=1 entry per resolved identity; (b) CONSOLIDATE actively evicts the absorbed/tombstoned profile from ALL rooms (broadcasting MEMBER_LEFT + corrected count), re-keying to the primary where needed; (c) a tombstoned CONNECT resolves to the primary, sends TOKEN_REDIRECT, and adds NO new member entry, with redirectTo IMMUTABLE and restart-durable; (d) addMember is idempotent by RESOLVED token. Plus a one-time gated repair collapses the already-corrupted Heartspaces members and restores the lost tombstones. Result: a user can NEVER appear as multiple members again.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: user appears as 3 members in Heartspaces — must NEVER happen again.

discoverySource.measured: vs src/ts/server/Room.ts + server.ts HEAD; 3 root causes: CONSOLIDATE never cleans room membership, members keyed by clientId deduped only in some output paths, redirectTo not immutable/restart-durable

model.crossRefNote: Structural hardening of R23.3 (identity merge cleans up room membership). R23.3 was the behavioural clean-up; R25.7 makes duplication STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE at 4 enforcement points + immutable redirectTo. R23.3 ghost-member ACs are now enforced by R25.7's structural points.

acceptanceCriteria.text: At room load, each persisted member's token is mapped through resolveToken and grouped by primary - room.members holds AT MOST ONE entry per resolved identity (not just one display path).

CONSOLIDATE, after setting redirectTo, evicts the absorbed profile from ALL rooms - removing/re-keying members that resolve to the primary and broadcasting MEMBER_LEFT + corrected memberCount (live, not only on next load).
A tombstoned CONNECT (redirectTo set) resolves to the PRIMARY: sends TOKEN_REDIRECT and addMember UNDER the primary token - never a second member entry for the tombstone.
redirectTo is IMMUTABLE and restart-durable - every profile save preserves it; IDENTIFY on a redirected token redirects and never re-mints/clears it (fixes the lost-tombstone bug).
Room.addMember dedups on RESOLVED token - if a member already resolves to the same primary, RE-KEY that entry instead of inserting a second.
memberCount and the JOIN output use allMemberInfo() (resolved + deduped), not the raw members map - so count and lists agree with the deduped identity set.
A one-time GATED migration (dry-run + count first, never silently drop a real member) collapses the 3 Heartspaces Marcel entries to primary 8f74dfba and restores redirectTo on 37fcb752 + 2703628c.

model.riNote: 4 enforcement UCs + invariant + one-time repair. The repair is an operational GATED migration task (not a UC). ACs a/b/c/immutable/d map to UC-RD.1-4; invariant folds into UC-RD.4; repair = migration task.
